title: Plan R: AI Video Editing / Clipping
summary: Asset review → find highlights → smart clipping → captions & packaging → platform versions → data optimization
scenario: Best for cutting long videos (live replays, long talks, courses) into short clips, or batch content from existing footage.

steps.title: Review assets and set goals
steps.detail: Decide which long videos to clip, the target platform, and each clip's theme and length; skim for likely highlight segments.
steps.tips: Decide 'what you're cutting for whom' before hunting highlights; a wrong topic wastes a good edit.

steps.title: Locate highlights
steps.detail: Transcribe with Whisper and have the AI flag 'bang / insight / quote / conflict' moments with timestamps, zeroing in on the best 30-90 second segments.
steps.tips: AI timestamps plus quick human confirmation is an order of magnitude faster than watching frame by frame.

steps.title: Smart clipping
steps.detail: Cut segments on the timestamps, drop filler and dead air; use AI caption alignment and optionally reorder or add transitions.
steps.tips: Cut on a complete sentence boundary, never mid-thought.

steps.title: Captions and packaging
steps.detail: AI captions (proofread proper nouns) plus title, stickers and intro; adapt to 9:16 vertical and highlight key words to hold attention.
steps.tips: Proofread names and jargon manually; put the hook in the first-3-seconds caption.

steps.title: Platform versions
steps.detail: Produce 9:16 vertical plus 16:9 horizontal from the same clip; adapt titles and cover copy per platform (AI generates variants, you pick).
steps.tips: Ship one clip with 2-3 titles across platforms to test which gets the clicks.

steps.title: Data optimization
steps.detail: Watch completion rate and drop-off points; feed the data to the AI to learn which highlight style cuts best, and iterate your clipping standard.
steps.tips: Log each clip's topic and cut style to build your own 'clipping playbook'.

pitfalls.title: Dragging pacing
pitfalls.detail: Clips that keep too much setup die; keep one highlight per clip and open with the hook in 3 seconds.

pitfalls.title: Caption typos
pitfalls.detail: AI captions mangle names and jargon; proofread before publishing.

pitfalls.title: Quality loss
pitfalls.detail: Repeated compression turns to mush; export at high bitrate and crop vertical from source rather than upscaling.

pitfalls.title: Repost compliance
pitfalls.detail: Clipping others' content risks copyright; cut only your own footage or with permission.
